title: Two tankers hit mines in Strait of Hormuz as US tightens blockade
en: Two oil tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after striking naval mines, Iran's Islamic Revolution Guard Corps said early Sunday, as Washington pressed ahead with its campaign against Iranian shipping. The IRGC navy said both vessels had switched off their navigation and GPS systems and were trying to use what it called an "unauthorized" route through the waterway. It warned that any ship cooperating with the American military and ignoring Iranian rules would "definitely" hit mines. Separately, US Central Command said an American aircraft fired precision munitions at the stern of the St Kitts-flagged cargo vessel M/V Huda in the Gulf of Oman, disabling it after the crew ignored repeated warnings. It was the 11th ship disabled since the blockade began in July.
zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队8日凌晨表示，两艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷起火，华盛顿则继续推进针对伊朗航运的行动。革命卫队海军称，两船均关闭了导航和GPS系统，试图经由其所说的“未经授权”航道通过该水域，并警告任何配合美军、无视伊朗规定的船只“必将”触雷。另外，美国中央司令部称，一架美军飞机向阿曼湾的圣基茨籍货船“M/V Huda”船尾发射精确弹药，在船员多次无视警告后使该船失去航行能力。这是7月封锁开始以来被瘫痪的第11艘船只。

title: US sets up Task Force Iron Gate to cut Iran land supply lines
en: After months of a naval blockade, the US military is creating a task force to tighten its squeeze on Iran's weapons supply lines. Task Force Iron Gate, a team of about 20 civilian and military personnel based in Tampa, Florida, will work with other US agencies to stop advanced weapons, dual-use technology and sanctioned goods moving across Iran's land borders and the Caspian Sea. Admiral Brad Cooper, who leads Central Command, said closer interagency coordination would "further constrain Iran's ability to finance terrorism, rebuild weapons factories, and replenish their military". CENTCOM estimates the blockade has already prevented Iran from exporting more than $25 billion of crude. Meanwhile, Vice-President JD Vance has personally joined indirect talks with Tehran, raising the level of negotiations, people familiar with the matter said.
zh: 在实施数月海上封锁之后，美国军方正组建一支特遣队，进一步收紧对伊朗武器供应链的围堵。这支名为“铁门”的特遣队由约20名文职和军事人员组成，驻扎在佛罗里达州坦帕市，将与美国其他机构合作，阻止先进武器、军民两用技术和受制裁物资经伊朗陆地边境及里海流动。中央司令部司令布拉德·库珀海军上将表示，加强跨部门协作将“进一步限制伊朗资助恐怖主义、重建武器工厂和补充军备的能力”。中央司令部估计，封锁已阻止伊朗出口价值超过250亿美元的原油。与此同时，知情人士称，副总统万斯已亲自介入与德黑兰的间接谈判，使磋商级别提升。

title: Berkshire operating profit slips 5.8% as cash pile hits record $377.4bn
en: Berkshire Hathaway reported third-quarter operating profit of $12.71 billion, down 5.8% from a year earlier, as underwriting income at its insurance arm weakened. Net income attributable to shareholders fell 28% to $22.11 billion, dragged down by investment gains of $9.41 billion, far below the $17.31 billion booked a year earlier. The conglomerate bought back $9.6 billion of its own stock in the quarter, its largest repurchase this year, while cash and short-term Treasuries climbed to a record $377.4 billion. It was the first quarterly report fully led by Greg Abel, who became chief executive on 1 January after Warren Buffett stepped down as chairman in September. Berkshire shares rose about 5% this week, outpacing the S&P 500's 2.68% decline.
zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦公布，第三季度营业利润为127.1亿美元，同比下降5.8%，原因是其保险板块承保收入走弱。归属股东净利润下降28%至221.12亿美元，主要受投资收益拖累——当季投资收益为94.07亿美元，远低于上年同期的173.11亿美元。该集团当季回购自家股票96亿美元，为今年最大规模回购；现金及短期美国国债升至创纪录的3774亿美元。这是格雷格·阿贝尔自1月1日接任首席执行官、沃伦·巴菲特9月卸任董事长后，首份完全由其主导的季报。伯克希尔股价本周上涨约5%，跑赢同期下跌2.68%的标普500指数。

title: Apple unveils HALO, a robot brain that carries simulated skills into real rooms
en: Apple researchers have unveiled HALO, an autonomous control system that lets a humanoid robot carry skills learned in simulation into unfamiliar real rooms. In a paper posted to arXiv, the team said it tested the system on Unitree's G1 robot across 360 single-task trials in six environments that had not been scanned or mapped in advance, achieving an average success rate of 91%. On three combined tasks the average fell to 70%, and one sequence — ducking under an obstacle, walking to a target and pushing a box — succeeded only half the time. HALO uses a three-layer architecture: a vision-language model plans tasks locally on a Mac mini, a smaller model generates about five seconds of whole-body motion, and a reinforcement-learned tracker runs at 50 hertz.
zh: 苹果研究人员公布了一套名为HALO的自主控制系统，可让人形机器人把在仿真环境中学到的技能带到陌生的真实房间中执行。团队在提交至arXiv的论文中称，该系统在宇树科技G1机器人上进行了验证：在6个未预先扫描或建图的真实环境中开展360次单项任务测试，平均成功率为91%。在三项组合任务上，平均成功率降至70%，其中“俯身通过障碍—走向目标—推箱子”这一串动作只有一半成功。HALO采用三层架构：一个视觉语言模型在机器人搭载的Mac mini上本地规划任务，一个较小的模型生成约5秒的全身动作，一个经强化学习训练的动作跟踪器以50赫兹频率运行。

title: China FX reserves edge up to $3.405trn as gold buying extends to 24th month
en: China's foreign exchange reserves rose to $3.4052 trillion at the end of October, up $4.9 billion, or 0.14%, from a month earlier, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange said. The regulator attributed the increase to a stronger dollar, mixed moves in global asset prices and the effect of currency translation, and said the economy's steady performance continued to underpin the stockpile. Gold reserves reached 78.3 million ounces after purchases of 830,000 ounces, the 24th consecutive monthly increase, central bank data showed. The World Gold Council said central banks and other official institutions added a net 321 tonnes in the third quarter, up 42% year on year, the strongest quarter since late 2024, with diversification and risk management remaining the main drivers.
zh: 国家外汇管理局表示，截至10月末，中国外汇储备规模升至3.4052万亿美元，较上月增加49亿美元，升幅0.14%。该局将上升归因于美元走强、全球资产价格涨跌互现以及汇率折算效应，并表示经济平稳运行继续为储备规模提供支撑。央行数据显示，黄金储备在增持83万盎司后达到7830万盎司，为连续第24个月增加。世界黄金协会称，三季度各国央行及其他官方机构净增黄金储备321吨，同比增长42%，为2024年末以来最强单季，储备多元化与风险管理仍是主要驱动因素。

title: Europe week of bomb hoaxes and hacked fridges puts infrastructure in focus
en: Europe spent the week grappling with a wave of bomb hoaxes and cyber attacks that disrupted flights, newsrooms and supermarket supply chains. At least 18 flights to and from Bulgaria, Cyprus, the Czech Republic, France, Hungary, Italy, Portugal, Romania and Britain were affected on Friday alone, with aircraft diverted or searched; no devices were found. Sky and Ireland's RTE both reported security threats. Days earlier, hackers raised freezer temperatures at stores in at least eleven countries, forcing retailers including Carrefour and IKEA to discard food, while a cyber attack damaged cold-storage systems at French blood banks. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said civilian infrastructure was clearly the target and argued the incidents showed why defence and security spending matters.
zh: 欧洲本周忙于应对一连串虚假炸弹威胁和网络攻击，航班、新闻编辑部和超市供应链均受到干扰。仅周五一天，至少18个往返保加利亚、塞浦路斯、捷克、法国、匈牙利、意大利、葡萄牙、罗马尼亚和英国的航班受到影响，飞机被迫改道或接受搜查，但未发现爆炸装置。英国天空电视台和爱尔兰RTE均报告遭到安全威胁。此前数日，黑客调高了至少11个国家门店的冷柜温度，迫使家乐福、宜家等零售商丢弃食品；一次网络攻击还破坏了法国血库的冷藏系统。意大利总理梅洛尼表示，民用基础设施显然已成为目标，这些事件说明国防与安全支出为何重要。
